step_by_step_reasoning: The whiteboard shows a data analytics architecture divided into Ingest, Store/Process, and Consume phases. Ingest consists of ALB sending data to Lambda, which passes it to Kinesis Firehose, delivering to S3. Store/Process contains S3, Glue (with a crawler interaction), Airflow scheduler, Athena, and Redshift. Consume contains Console and BI Tools, with a Lambda function triggering refresh on BI Tools.
